items.exampleEn: He scored twice in the first half.
The fans celebrated the team's victory in the streets.
items.exampleZh: 球迷在街上慶祝球隊的勝利。

items.exampleEn: Our school team plays in a local league.
items.exampleZh: 我們的校隊在地方聯賽中比賽。

items.exampleEn: I don't like to compete with my friends.
My friend is so competitive that he hates losing, even at cards.
items.exampleZh: 我朋友好勝心很強，連玩紙牌都討厭輸。

items.exampleEn: I bet it will rain this afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 我敢說今天下午會下雨。

items.exampleEn: She was the national chess champion at sixteen.
items.exampleZh: 她十六歲時是全國西洋棋冠軍。

items.exampleEn: The tennis tournament lasts two weeks.
items.exampleZh: 這場網球錦標賽為期兩週。

items.sentenceEn: Who scored the last goal in the game?
items.sentenceZh: 比賽最後一球是誰進的？

items.audioEn: Our team won the league last year, but this year we finished third.
items.audioZh: 我們隊去年拿下聯賽冠軍，但今年得了第三名。

items.sentenceEn: Many companies compete for young customers.
items.sentenceZh: 許多公司爭取年輕的顧客。

items.sentenceEn: Tennis is a very competitive sport.
items.sentenceZh: 網球是競爭非常激烈的運動。

items.stemEn: Our school won the city basketball ____ last month.
items.stemZh: 我們學校上個月贏得了全市籃球錦標賽。

items.stemEn: More than fifty runners will ____ in tomorrow's race.
items.stemZh: 明天的賽跑將有五十多名跑者參賽。

items.passageEn: Mia plays for a small tennis club. This year, her club joined a local league, and the games were hard. Mia is very competitive, so she practices every day. In the final tournament of the season, she played against last year's champion. The score was close, but Mia won. After the victory, her coach said, "I bet you'll be the best in the country one day!" The whole club had a party, and a magician entertained the children.
items.passageZh: Mia 在一個小網球俱樂部打球。今年，她的俱樂部加入了地方聯賽，比賽都很辛苦。Mia 好勝心很強，所以每天練習。在本季最後的錦標賽中，她和去年的冠軍對打。比數很接近，但 Mia 贏了。勝利後，教練說：「我敢說你有一天會是全國最強的！」整個俱樂部辦了派對，還有一位魔術師逗孩子們開心。

questions.questionZh: 最後的錦標賽中，Mia 和誰對打？

items.promptZh: 我們隊今年在聯賽中得了第二名。
referenceEn: Our team finished second in the league this year.
This year, our team came second in the league.
rubricZh: league 表示「聯賽、聯盟」，例如 in the league 等說法
「得第二名」可寫，例如 finish second、come second 等
時態配合內容（例如說已經發生的事用過去式）

items.promptZh: 這場勝利對整個小鎮來說意義重大。
referenceEn: This victory means a lot to the whole town.
The victory is very important to the whole town.
rubricZh: 「意義重大」可寫，例如 means a lot to、is very important to 等
